title: Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius (SNES) - High Speed Patrol (Shooting Gallery)
description:
It's the city from the SNES version. Removed the karts, as those take many tiles. Have fun!

Small update:
-Moved the tiles from FG2 to BG3;
-Made the street color use the back area color, saving 1 palette;
-Added the required street HDMA that came from the level.

No credit needed.
